notes: Frozen with protocol.md and params.json. Families: F1 prediction buckets (HoldoutBucketEvaluator + BH), F2 catalyst groups (EventStudyEngine BMP + placebo + BH), F3 timing (descriptive, Wilson/bootstrap CIs, never 'significant'), F4 strategy grids (SPA + DSR), F5 structural (group-diff + BH). Primaries with a p-value are additionally Holm-corrected across families. H4 and H5 are descriptive primaries judged by intervals only.

hypotheses.claim: The top quintile of pmVolRatio at 08:00 has precision for reach20By0945 at least 3x the base rate among candidate days.
hypotheses.label: reach20By0945
hypotheses.notes: Base rate = P(reach20By0945) over all candidate days with a bar by 08:00. Bins = 5 on the training-fit quintile edges.

hypotheses.claim: Gappers with an Fda, ContractAward or MA catalyst in [t-24h, t] continue after 10:30 (fwdClose_16:00 minus fwdClose_10:30 at t=09:30) more than no-catalyst gappers.
hypotheses.feature: catalystType in {Fda, ContractAward, MA} vs hasCatalyst = false
hypotheses.label: fwdClose_16:00 - fwdClose_10:30
hypotheses.notes: Tier20 gapper days only. Placebo reassigns the catalyst group within the same day.

hypotheses.claim: No-catalyst Tier20 gappers fade (close at or below pmHigh - 30%) more often than catalyst gappers.
hypotheses.label: fadeFlag30
hypotheses.notes: Day-clustered bootstrap on the proportion difference; BH within F2.

hypotheses.claim: At least 60% of Tier50 gapper days print the RTH high of day before 09:46.
hypotheses.label: hodTimeRth < 09:46
hypotheses.notes: Tests the 'take the money within a minute of the bell' belief against the vendor's ~50%-by-09:45 figure. Supported if the Wilson 95% interval lies entirely above 0.60; refuted if entirely below; else undecided. Descriptive only.

hypotheses.claim: Among Tier20 gappers with a velocity death, the median deathToHodMin lies in [-2, +5] minutes, and fewer than 25% of full-session highs fall in the 09:30-09:31 bucket.
hypotheses.label: deathToHodMin; hodBucket = 09:30-09:31
hypotheses.notes: Two parts, both must hold. Median by day-clustered bootstrap interval; bucket share by Wilson interval. Tests 'velocity dies ~15 min before the bell' against 'sell into the auction'. Descriptive only.

hypotheses.claim: D-1 abnormal volume at least 3x ADV20 at least doubles the probability of a Tier20 gapper day on D among universe members.
hypotheses.label: isTier20Gapper
hypotheses.notes: Population is U(D), not candidates, so the base rate is the unconditional gapper rate.

hypotheses.claim: A reverse split within the prior 30 days lowers fwdClose_10:30 (entry at 09:30) and raises fade among Tier20 gappers.
hypotheses.label: fwdClose_10:30; fade
hypotheses.notes: Both labels must move in the claimed direction; each gets its own BH-corrected p within F5.

hypotheses.claim: At least one Form 4 open-market purchase in [D-30, D-1 16:00] raises the probability of a Tier20 gapper day on D.
hypotheses.label: isTier20Gapper
hypotheses.notes: Dropped, not redefined, if CIK coverage of candidate symbols is below 50%. Population restricted to CIK-mapped symbols.

hypotheses.claim: v_3 above 1%/min and pmVolRatio above 5 at 09:00 predict fwdMax_09:45 >= 10% with lift at least 2 over the candidate-day base rate.
hypotheses.label: fwdMax_09:45 >= 0.10
hypotheses.notes: Entry is the next-bar open after 09:00.

hypotheses.claim: A 424B filing within the prior 10 days raises Tier20 probability on candidate days and makes fwdClose_16:00 (entry 09:30) negative on gapper days.
hypotheses.label: isTier20Gapper; fwdClose_16:00
hypotheses.notes: Two parts; each BH-corrected within F5.

hypotheses.claim: A feature detector on the 08:00 snapshot beats the catalyst-latency benchmark (a news item or 8-K with pubToTMinutes <= 60 exists at 08:00) by at least 0.05 AUC for reach20By0945 on validation.
hypotheses.feature: 08:00 core feature set (logistic, fit on train) vs benchmark indicator pubToTMinutes <= 60
hypotheses.label: reach20By0945
hypotheses.notes: Gatekeeper. If this fails on validation, strategy work stops and the write-up says 'catalyst latency is the edge.' DeLong-style day-block bootstrap for the AUC difference. The detector is fit on train only.

hypotheses.claim: A rule built from H1/H9 (enter at the next-bar open after a pass at 08:30; exit on velocity death, VWAP loss, 09:28 sell-by, or stop) nets at least +1.0%/trade after the frozen cost model on a grid of at most 24 configurations.
hypotheses.label: net return per trade
hypotheses.notes: Grid in params.json. Selection on train by clustered 2.5% bound; SPA and DSR on validation; holdout once. Holdout promotion threshold is +0.5%/trade with lower bound > 0.

hypotheses.claim: Tier20 gappers whose extension from the 09:30 open at 09:45 is below 10% close below the open at least 85% of the time.
hypotheses.label: closeBelowOpen

hypotheses.claim: On Tier50 gapper days, selling at the 09:30 open beats selling at 09:15 net of cost (paired per event).
hypotheses.label: sell price at 09:30 open minus sell price at 09:15 close, net of the frozen cost at each time
hypotheses.notes: Paired difference per event; day-clustered bootstrap. No grid, so SPA is not applied; reported with the F4 cost model.

hypotheses.claim: Being in the top 20 of U(D-1) by daily return on D-1 raises the probability of a Tier20 gapper day on D.
hypotheses.label: isTier20Gapper

hypotheses.claim: Gappers whose latest catalyst is promotional (deterministic CatalystPreClassifier class PromoPr, or source tier promotional) reverse by 16:00 (negative fwdClose_16:00 at 09:30) while wire-sourced non-promotional catalysts continue.
hypotheses.feature: catalystPreClass = PromoPr OR sourceTier = promotional, vs sourceTier = wire AND preClass != PromoPr
hypotheses.label: fwdClose_16:00
hypotheses.notes: Promotional is decided by the frozen CatalystPreClassifier keyword rules (class PromoPr) plus any sources named in params.json promotionalSources; the named list may be empty without voiding the hypothesis.

hypotheses.claim: A collapse in the 5-minute trade-count rate (tradesRoc <= -0.5) occurs within the 5 minutes before the full-session high more often than within a random 5-minute window of the same session.
hypotheses.label: hodTime
hypotheses.notes: Ait-Sahalia et al. 2024 exhaustion signature. Descriptive: Wilson interval on the conditional share vs the unconditional per-window frequency on the same days.
